ai.synthesis: This face-scan wellness estimate shows several metrics within the app's preset comparison ranges alongside five values that fall outside those thresholds: High Total Cholesterol Risk, Wellness Score, Heart Rate, PNS Zone (Recovery), and SNS Zone (Stress Response). Blood Pressure, Breathing Rate, Oxygen Saturation, and Stress Index estimates are within the app's preset ranges, while the blood-related risk and biomarker metrics are experimental estimates still under research rather than laboratory results. Overall, the pattern reflects an estimated resting pulse above the preset range alongside autonomic indices weighted toward sympathetic activity, without establishing any clinical status.

findings.label: Risks
findings.text: High Total Cholesterol Risk is flagged High against a desired Low setting, meaning this experimental estimate exceeds the app's preset wellness threshold. High Blood Pressure Risk, High Hemoglobin A1c Risk, High Fasting Glucose Risk, and Low Hemoglobin Risk are marked Low (with the latter three being experimental estimates not equivalent to lab tests), while ASCVD Risk (1%) and Heart Age (22 years) are neutral model outputs.

findings.label: Basic Vital Signs
findings.text: Heart Rate (102 BPM) exceeds the app's preset wellness threshold of 60-100 BPM, and Wellness Score (6) falls outside the preset desired threshold of greater than 6. Blood Pressure (121/80 mmHg), Breathing Rate (14 RPM), and Oxygen Saturation (98%) are within the app's preset ranges, while Wellness Level (2) and PRQ (7.1 vs. ~5) are listed as neutral comparisons.

findings.label: Bloodless Blood Tests
findings.text: Estimated Hemoglobin A1c (5.62% vs. preset < 5.7%) and Hemoglobin (14.2 g/dL vs. preset M:14-18, F:12-16) fall within the app's preset comparison ranges. Both values are experimental estimates from a research-stage feature and are not equivalent to clinical laboratory blood tests.

findings.label: Stress
findings.text: Stress Level (categorized as "Normal" within the app's Low/Normal preset range), Stress Index (139 vs. < 150), and Normalized Stress Index (27% vs. < 40%) all fall within the app's preset wellness comparison thresholds.

findings.label: Advanced Heart Rate Variability
findings.text: SNS Zone (Stress Response) is flagged High against a preset target of Normal, exceeding the app's preset wellness threshold, and PNS Zone (Recovery) is flagged Low against a preset target of Normal, falling outside the app's preset wellness threshold. Supporting HRV metrics (PNS Index -1.4, SNS Index 2.5, Mean RRI 571 ms, RMSSD 42 ms, SDNN 56 ms, SD1 24 ms, SD2 75 ms, and LF/HF Ratio 1.275) are displayed without preset target ranges.

next_steps: Review the flagged Heart Rate, Wellness Score, PNS Zone, SNS Zone, and experimental High Total Cholesterol Risk estimates with a licensed clinician and confirm them using validated clinical equipment or standard laboratory blood testing.

Repeat the scan under standardized resting conditions—seated quietly for at least 5 minutes, away from caffeine, exercise, or acute stress—to see whether the estimated Heart Rate and HRV zones remain outside the preset thresholds.
Do not start, stop, or adjust any medications or treatments based solely on these face-scan estimates.
ai.limitations: A single camera-based face scan cannot account for lighting, movement, hydration, posture, or transient physiological changes, and cannot replace validated medical instruments or laboratory assays. This is a wellness estimate, not a diagnosis, and any flagged value should be confirmed with validated clinical equipment or a licensed clinician.
